title: The descriptions of the penalty contacts name the impact models by ContactImpactModel
author: Claude-JG
description: The descriptions of ObjectContactSphereSphere, SphereTorus, SphereTriangle and SphereCylinder named the impact model only by its number m_impact or by the parameter impactModel, while the Python value is exu.ContactImpactModel.Linear, HuntCrossley or GonthierCarvalhoMartins. Decided: the descriptions name the values of ContactImpactModel and link its page.
releaseNotes: The descriptions of the sphere contacts name the impact models by exu.ContactImpactModel.Linear, HuntCrossley and GonthierCarvalhoMartins and link its page.
